00207.patient_consent_support: Discuss the treatment aim, alternatives, expected benefit, serious and lasting risks, fertility/pregnancy precautions and the contact plan. Confirm RAS selection for colorectal treatment, infusion premedication, skin care and post-treatment mineral checks. Discuss severe or delayed infusion reactions and the agreed observation plan; a previous severe cetuximab reaction must be reported even after recovery.
clinician_review_points: This colorectal context requires EGFR-expressing, validated extended RAS-wild-type metastatic disease after failure of oxaliplatin- and irinotecan-based therapy AND intolerance to irinotecan.

Previous grade 3–4 cetuximab infusion reactions remain a contraindication after symptoms recover. Skin restart requires episode count, recovery interval and actual prior maintenance dose; do not re-escalate.

NCCP p1 permits cessation of observation after two tolerated cetuximab doses, whereas Erbitux SmPC section 4.2 requires monitoring during and for at least one hour after each infusion. Reconcile and document the local observation plan; do not promise early discharge.

00328.patient_consent_support: Discuss the treatment aim, alternatives, expected benefit, serious and lasting risks, fertility/pregnancy precautions and the contact plan. Confirm RAS selection for colorectal treatment, infusion premedication, skin care and post-treatment mineral checks. Explain DPD testing and the exact pump schedule. Explain early and delayed diarrhoea separately.  Discuss severe or delayed infusion reactions and the agreed observation plan; a previous severe cetuximab reaction must be reported even after recovery. Explain that folinic acid supports fluorouracil and follows its bolus hold/omission plan; DPD testing, heart symptoms and current/recent interacting medicines can change whether fluorouracil is given. Discuss how previous severe diarrhoea, low blood counts, bilirubin and known UGT1A1 results may change irinotecan dosing and monitoring.
clinician_review_points: Folinic acid follows the bolus 5-FU hold/omission for complete or unconfirmed DPD status, 5-FU cardiotoxicity, hepatic contraindication and contraindicated DPD-inhibitor exposure. Folinic acid is not a standalone substitute.

5-FU bilirubin >85 µmol/L or absolute AST >180 is contraindicated; exact equality is a source gap requiring review. The AST table does not print units: verify analyte/unit rather than entering ALT or an ULN ratio.

Irinotecan bilirubin >3×ULN is contraindicated. Renal impairment and UGT1A1 poor-metaboliser status, including homozygous *6 or *28, require individual review; do not import a numerical reduction from another regimen.
Reconcile brivudin/sorivudin/analogue current or recent exposure before 5-FU; the tool does not infer a safe washout interval.

NCCP p1 permits cessation of observation after two tolerated cetuximab doses, whereas Erbitux SmPC section 4.2 requires monitoring during and for at least one hour after each infusion. Reconcile and document the local observation plan; do not promise early discharge.

00733.patient_consent_support: Discuss the treatment aim, alternatives, expected benefit, serious and lasting risks, fertility/pregnancy precautions and the contact plan. Confirm RAS selection for colorectal treatment, infusion premedication, skin care and post-treatment mineral checks. Explain DPD testing and the exact pump schedule.  Discuss severe or delayed infusion reactions and the agreed observation plan; a previous severe cetuximab reaction must be reported even after recovery. Explain that folinic acid supports fluorouracil and follows its bolus hold/omission plan; DPD testing, heart symptoms and current/recent interacting medicines can change whether fluorouracil is given. Discuss potentially persistent nerve damage, the effect of previous severe neuropathy on future oxaliplatin, and cold-triggered symptoms; improvement does not automatically permit rechallenge. The clinical team should reconcile the NCCP unlicensed-posology footnote with the current product information and document any applicable local consent requirements.
clinician_review_points: Prior grade 4 oxaliplatin neuropathy excludes the source rechallenge pathway even after recovery. Good recovery from grade 3 allows only specialist consideration, one level below the dose at onset, with previous dose history confirmed.
Folinic acid follows bolus 5-FU hold/omission. Bilirubin >85 µmol/L or absolute AST >180 contraindicates 5-FU; equality and uncertain AST unit/analyte require review.
CrCl <30 or haemodialysis permits consideration of 50% original oxaliplatin in this source; it is not an automatic prescription. Do not substitute a different FOLFOX regimen renal policy.

NCCP 00733 p9 retains an unlicensed-posology consent footnote. The current Erbitux SmPC section 4.2 now explicitly includes 500 mg/m² every two weeks for RAS-wild-type colorectal disease. Reconcile current local licensing/consent status; do not present the older footnote as an unquestioned current restriction or silently delete it.

NCCP p1 permits cessation of observation after two tolerated cetuximab doses, whereas Erbitux SmPC section 4.2 requires monitoring during and for at least one hour after each infusion. Reconcile and document the local observation plan; do not promise early discharge.

00456.patient_consent_support: Discuss the aim and alternatives, blood-count suppression and serious infection, kidney/hearing/nerve injury, nausea, hair loss, infusion reactions, fertility, and chest radiation effects including swallowing and breathing problems. Etoposide for NSCLC is outside its licensed indication; explain the rationale and follow local off-label consent policy. Discuss that recovery from severe side effects may require reduced doses or a change of platinum medicine; the actual previous dose and radiation plan must be reviewed together.
clinician_review_points: Direct PDF rendering confirms full-dose etoposide count criteria ANC ≥1.5 AND platelets ≥100. Underlines are separate PDF drawing objects, so plain text incorrectly reads >. Decimal gaps (1.49,1.5) and (99,100) remain review; exact 1.5/100 are not gaps.
NCCP reduced count rows still require reconciliation with the etoposide SmPC. Count rows apply to etoposide and do not clear cisplatin independently.

After grade 3 non-haematological toxicity (excluding mucositis/alopecia), wait for recovery to grade 1 or less; the source 75% restart requires dose-history and denominator review. Grade 4 is outside that source row.

After grade ≥2 neuropathy recovers to ≤1, a consultant chooses carboplatin AUC5 substitution or 50% cisplatin. Do not restore full-dose cisplatin automatically or substitute the separate AUC3 regimen.
